However, this method can be problematic when the conditional probabilities are uniformly spaced and the factor loadings, u, are normally distributed.

By estimating the constant threshold and the sign and magnitude of the factor loadings, we can obtain maximum likelihood estimates of the preference distribution and the conditional probabilities.
